title: 液滴入水边界与诊断修复 (GH #408)

physical_problem.description: 二维液滴在重力作用下落入静止液池，发生撞击、界面变形与并合。使用 D2Q9 Free-Energy 两相流模型。
physical_problem.geometry: 2D rectangular domain with physical tank boundaries (bottom wall + side walls + outflow)

initial_condition.droplet: circular, radius R, centered at (nx/2, water_level - R - gap)
initial_condition.pool: static liquid below y = water_level, gas above

physical_problem.governing_equations: D2Q9 Free-Energy LBM with phase-field advection and Korteweg capillary force
external_anchor: Worthington (1908) 'A Study of Splashes' — classic water entry
Truscott, Epps & Belden (2014) Annu. Rev. Fluid Mech. 46 355 — review of water entry
Swift et al. (1996) Phys. Rev. E 54 5041 — Free-Energy LBM foundation
Lee & Lin (2005) J. Comput. Phys. 209 1 — phase-field LBM for large density ratios

gh408_items.description: 周期 streaming → 物理水槽边界（底壁+侧壁+出流）
gh408_items.rationale: Periodic streaming is unphysical for droplet impact. Need: bottom wall (bounce-back), side walls (bounce-back or outflow), top (outflow/pressure BC).
gh408_items.implementation: Replace periodic stream with bounce-back on bottom/sides, pressure/outflow on top

gh408_items.description: 初始水面线=静态定义，与动态界面分离
gh408_items.rationale: The initial water level should be a static reference line, distinct from the evolving dynamic interface
gh408_items.implementation: Keep water_level as static reference; dynamic interface tracked via phi=0 contour

gh408_items.description: 合并后质心追踪改语义（报两相质量加权或停止报）
gh408_items.rationale: After coalescence, 'droplet centroid' is meaningless. Report two-phase mass-weighted centroid or stop reporting
gh408_items.implementation: Change to report mass-weighted centroid of all liquid phase, with clear semantic documentation

gh408_items.description: Boussinesq 近似 → cAC 真实水气密度比通路
gh408_items.rationale: Current Boussinesq uses rho_heavy/rho_light as effective density scaling. Need pathway to real water-air density ratio (~1000:1) via cAC (Allen-Cahn) formulation
gh408_items.implementation: Add density_ratio parameter pathway; connect to LBM-P0-CAC-G; do NOT parallel-build

impact_force_peak.threshold: Order-of-magnitude consistent with literature (F_peak ~ ρU²D for water entry)
impact_force_peak.tolerance: Within 1 order of magnitude of analytical estimate

mass_conservation.metric: Relative phase-mass drift over full simulation

interface_morphology.metric: Interface shape evolution (splash crown, cavity formation)
interface_morphology.threshold: Qualitatively consistent with Worthington splash morphology

boundary_correctness.threshold: Zero population flux through solid boundaries

stopping_rules.max_phi: If |phi| > 1.5 anywhere, stop and flag numerical instability
stopping_rules.mass_drift: If relative mass drift > 5%, stop and flag conservation failure
stopping_rules.max_speed: If max |u| > 0.3 (lattice), stop and flag CFL violation

confounders: Grid resolution affects interface thickness and parasitic currents
Time step (implicit in lattice units) affects stability
Density ratio limited by Free-Energy model stability (~10:1 typical)

analysis_plan.aggregation: Time-series of mass drift, centroid, max speed, kinetic energy
analysis_plan.comparison: Before/after boundary fix comparison on identical parameters
analysis_plan.validation: Compare impact force peak order-of-magnitude with analytical estimate
